title: Rust: .ok()? chains lose error context in routing
description: lichen-node/src/routing/router.rs and lichen-node/src/dispatch.rs use .ok()? to convert structured errors (DaoError, CoapError) into None, discarding diagnostic information. An AI watching test failures sees 'returned None' with no indication of why parsing/validation failed. Fix: propagate errors with ? operator, or log before converting. Example: Dao::from_bytes(data).ok()? hides the specific DaoError variant.
